name: banded-y
instructions:
1. Assume a standing position with your arms directly in front of you holding a band with a neutral grip.
2. Inhale and reach directly overhead so that the arms form a Y with the rest of your body.
3. Slowly lower the band back to the starting position under control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
